$comment: Machine-checkable claude.exe invocation contract from spike T16 (#48). T17b builds its invocation from this file. After a Claude Code upgrade, re-run the spike and diff this file. Placeholders: {model}, {systemPromptFile}, {jsonSchema}; %VAR% are Windows environment variables. Details: docs/spikes/claude-isolation.md.

argNotes.{systemPromptFile}: absolute path of a UTF-8 file under %LOCALAPPDATA%\com.misstheaim.prompttranslator\tmp; --system-prompt-file works on 2.1.309 although --help does not list it
argNotes.{jsonSchema}: the LLM output schema as an inline JSON string (minified); a file path is rejected with 'Error: --json-schema is not valid JSON'

stdin: The user's text, UTF-8, then close stdin. Must be non-empty: empty stdin exits 1 with 'Error: Input must be provided either through stdin or as a prompt argument when using --print' on stderr.

spawn.killOnTimeout: whole process tree (Job Object or taskkill /T /F)

outcomes.success: exit 0, stdout is one JSON envelope, is_error false, structured_output is the object that matches the schema (result holds the same object as a JSON string)
outcomes.schemaNotSatisfied: exit 0, is_error false, subtype success, structured_output ABSENT, result is the model's free text: treat as MalformedOutput
outcomes.notSignedIn: exit 1, stdout envelope with is_error true and result 'Not logged in · Please run /login'
outcomes.cliError: exit 1, stdout empty, one 'Error: ...' line on stderr (bad --json-schema, missing --system-prompt-file, empty stdin)

authCheck.notes: No API call. Prints JSON {loggedIn, authMethod, apiProvider, subscriptionType, ...}; exit 0 when signed in, exit 1 with loggedIn false when not.
